bluf: France 24 reported that three Russian projectiles came down in Poland on Friday, prompting NATO to condemn what it called a grave violation of Polish airspace. France 24 also reported a drone strike set a Russian cargo ship ablaze in the Gulf of Finland before it drifted into Finnish territorial waters, where Finnish authorities alerted NATO and imposed temporary restrictions; the outlet reported the Saudi-led coalition intercepted three ballistic missiles fired toward Riyadh early Saturday.

changes.text: Updated since previous brief: Aramco Tower hit in heart of Saudi capital as Houthis launch fresh strikes

cyber.text: The Record reported that researchers said a China-linked threat actor used the Cairn AI tool to persistently attack two universities and possibly discover a zero-day bug in one case.

items.text: France 24 reported that three Russian projectiles came down in Poland on Friday and that NATO condemned what it called a grave violation of Polish airspace.

France 24 reported that a Russian cargo ship caught fire after a drone strike in international waters in the Gulf of Finland, then drifted into Finnish territorial waters; Finnish authorities alerted NATO and imposed temporary restrictions in the area.
BBC News World reported that Russia struck bridges and railway stations in Kyiv in a major attack.

France 24 reported that the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted and destroyed three ballistic missiles fired toward Riyadh early Saturday, marking the second Houthi attack on the Saudi capital in recent days.
